title: Hymn piano arrangements by Kimi-K3 (v1)
description: Three solo-piano arrangements of public-domain hymns (Amazing Grace, America the Beautiful, Battle Hymn of the Republic), each written in LilyPond by Kimi-K3 from a brief generated from the hymn's melody, chords and stanzas, as used under the ai-jam-sessions sung exemplars. Each package has the brief, the system prompt, the model's answer as returned, the compiled arrangement, the generation record (model, settings, sha256s, usage, cost) and the imported notes. Two of the three answers needed a one-line hand fix, listed in README.md. Public domain: every hymn edition followed is from 1919 or earlier and every author died before 1930 (sources in README.md and the Battle Hymn's receipt.json). Licence: CC0 1.0. CC0 waives whatever rights exist; AI-generated arrangement content may carry little or no copyright in some jurisdictions. The Kimi K3 License claims no rights in outputs. OpenRouter (Amazing Grace, America) and Ollama Cloud (Battle Hymn) each hold a non-exclusive licence in the content sent through them; whether OpenRouter prompt logging was on for the account at generation time is not recorded (it widens OpenRouter's licence, not ours). Generation: Amazing Grace and America 2026-10-08 via OpenRouter (provider Modal); Battle Hymn 2026-09-26 via Ollama Cloud, before the studio stopped using it.
